mentions.name: Video Reject
mentions.description: A marketplace platform for people to buy and sell physical media, described as Reverb but for physical media. It aims to build a community of folks with the same interests and is preparing for launch with a waitlist.
mentions.audience: Movie lovers and collectors who want to buy and sell physical media
mentions.source_excerpt: Video Reject is a platform for people to buy/sell physical media. Like Reverb but for physical media.

evidence.value: Video Reject is a platform for people to buy/sell physical media. Like Reverb but for physical media.
